name: ShakeBody_2
short_caption: The robot shivers or shakes its shoulders while tilting its head.
movement_description: The robot starts by tilting its head to the right while slightly lifting its shoulders and rotating its hands outward. It then shifts its head to the left and repeats a similar subtle shoulder and body shaking motion. Finally, the robot straightens up, aligns its head to the front, and returns its arms to the neutral hanging position.
safety_notes: The robot moves its arms slightly outward, requiring minimal clearance.
